name: Itamar Ben-Gvir
role: Israeli national security minister and leader of Otzma Yehudit
summary: Ben-Gvir, a Kahanist-rooted nationalist, seeks Israeli sovereignty and Jewish settlement across the West Bank and Gaza, encouraged Arab emigration and no Palestinian state. He favours a Jewish-character state, politician-appointed judges and weaker legal advisers, armed citizens, and the death penalty for terrorists.
